data.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'Selene', meaning 'Moon'. In Greek mythology, Selene was the goddess of the moon. The name Cynthea is a variation of this name. The name Cynthea carries the meaning “Moon Goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cynthea usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
